text.p: Russian doctors in the southern city of Krasnodar have answered their countrymen's prayers and invented a vodka which they say that is truly good for health.

"Made with water containing silver ions and passed through a magnetic field, it possesses antibiotic properties and a curative effect," Itar-Tass news agency quoted the doctors saying of "Silver Spring" vodka, which went on sale on Sunday.

Millions of Russians swear by the medicinal effects of their national drink. But doctors blame heavy vodka drinking for a male life expectancy of just 58, far below the level in other industrialised countries.
